components.name: DatePicker
components.description:
Figma `Date-Picker/Single-Calendar` (895:31954) and `Date-Picker/Dual-Calendar` on the shared token and
Button primitives. The single calendar's month/year opens the Select-Month-Year state. It is
also the calendar surface used by Input/Date-Field. With `showActions` (Figma Actions,
`.Primitives/Date-Picker/Action` 460:38871) picks are a draft: Submit applies it through `onApply(value, range)`,
Cancel drops it (`onCancel`) and the calendar shows the applied `value` / `range` again.
As a popover (`onClose` / `onOpenChange` / `anchorRef`) it is the Single-Calendar surface: Color/Background/Popover/
Default, Color/Border/Popover/Subtle, Corner-Radius/3XLarge, Spacing/Padding/Medium and Effect/Popover. Inline (none of
those) it sits in the flow of its container with no surface, as Figma's in-place calendar (`.Primitives/Date-Picker/
Calendar` 478:30561, `Date-Picker/Mobile` 9923:3576: no fill, stroke or effect), so it never casts a popover shadow.
Semantics follow: the popover is a `role="dialog"`, the inline calendar a `role="group"` (part of the page, not a
window over it); both are named "Choose date" / "Choose dates" unless `aria-label` / `aria-labelledby` name them.
Today's day carries `aria-current="date"`.

props.name: open
props.description: Default true: DatePicker is the calendar panel itself. As a popover, pass `open` with `onOpenChange` (or `onClose`).

props.name: value
props.description: Single mode, controlled: the selected date. With `showActions` it is the applied date; picks stay a draft until Submit.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: Single mode, uncontrolled: the date selected at first.

props.name: range
props.description: Range mode, controlled: the selected range. With `showActions` it is the applied range; picks stay a draft until Submit.

props.name: defaultRange
props.description: Range mode, uncontrolled: the range selected at first.

props.name: month
props.description: First (left) visible month.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description:
Called with each picked date; in range mode with the start, then again with the end (see `onRangeChange`). With
`showActions` a pick is a draft: read the applied value in `onApply`.

props.name: onRangeChange
props.description:
Range mode: called with the new start (end = null) and again once the end date is picked. With `showActions`
these are drafts: read the applied range in `onApply`.

props.name: onApply
props.type: (value: Date | null, range: DatePickerRange | null, time?: DatePickerTime) => void
props.description:
With `showActions`, pressing Submit (the Primary action) applies the picks, then closes a popover. Called with the
picked date (single mode; null in range mode) and the picked range (range mode; null in single mode). An
uncontrolled picker keeps what was applied and Cancel returns to it; a controlled one expects `value` / `range` to
follow. Inline, Submit is disabled until there is a change, and in range mode until the end date is picked.

props.name: onCancel
props.description:
With `showActions`, pressing Cancel (the Tertiary action) drops the picks made since the last Submit (the
calendar shows the applied value again), then calls this and closes a popover. Inline, Cancel is disabled while
there is nothing to drop. Escape and an outside click close a popover without applying, too.

props.name: onClose
props.description:
Popover behaviour: called on a pointer-down outside the picker (and outside `anchorRef`), on
Escape, after a single date / a complete range is picked (without actions), and by the actions.

props.name: onOpenChange
props.description: Called with `false` wherever `onClose` is called (the `open` / `onOpenChange` pair of every Zen overlay).

props.name: anchorRef
props.description: The trigger. Pointer-downs on it are left to its own toggle; Escape returns focus to it.

props.name: showActions
props.description:
Figma `Actions`: Cancel + Submit under the calendar. Picks are then a draft that Submit applies (`onApply`) and
Cancel drops (`onCancel`); without actions a pick applies at once.

props.name: action
props.description: `.Primitives/Date-Picker/Action`: `dual` (Cancel + Submit, default) or `single` (Submit only).

props.name: calendar
props.description:
Figma Date-Picker/Single-Calendar or Date-Picker/Dual-Calendar (two consecutive months side by
side; Static headers with Back on the first and Next on the second).

props.name: device
props.description:
Figma Date-Picker/Mobile (9923:3576) primitives: `mobile` days fill the width (square cells in Body/Base/Medium,
`.Primitives/Mobile-Date-Picker/Item` 9921:3283) under a Heading/Subheading month with Back / Next at the end,
Spacing/Gap/XLarge apart (Gap/XSmall for the dual calendar, whose months stack Gap/Medium apart). Unset, an inline
calendar follows the breakpoint (the nearest `data-breakpoint`, else ZenProvider) and a popover stays `desktop`
(Figma has no mobile popover). A `mobile` popover spans its containing block (a DateField's width).

props.name: timePicker
props.description:
Figma `Time-Picker`: a Divider and `.Primitives/Date-Picker/Time-Picker` under the calendar — From / To times
(hh:mm + AM/PM) and All day; stacked on the single calendar, side by side on the dual one. Picking a date no longer
closes a popover (the times come next): pair it with `showActions`, whose Submit applies date and time together.

props.name: time
props.description: Controlled times (with `timePicker`); with `showActions` it is the applied time.

props.name: defaultTime
props.default: { from: null, to: null, fromAllDay: false, toAllDay: false }
props.description: Uncontrolled times at first.

props.name: onTimeChange
props.description: Called with each time change; with `showActions` it is a draft, read the applied one in `onApply`.

props.name: today
props.description:
The day the calendar treats as today: the Today ring (`.Primitives/Date-Picker/Item` State=Today) and the month it
opens on without a value. Default: the device clock. Pass your app's date when it is not the device's (a server or
business date, a demo world, a test).

props.name: aria-label
props.description:
Accessible name of the calendar. Default: the locale's "Choose date" ("Choose dates" for the dual calendar). Name an
inline calendar after what it sets ("Start date") when a form shows more than one.

props.name: aria-labelledby
props.description: id of a visible element that names the calendar (a heading or label next to an inline calendar); wins over `aria-label`.

props.name: labelOptional
props.description: Figma Label `Optional` / `Tooltip-Icon` / `Action` for the field label (see InputLabel).

props.name: helpTheme
props.description: Figma Help-Text Theme for `helpText`: Neutral (default) · Warning · Positive · Negative. `error` always renders Negative.

props.name: helpIcon
props.description: Figma Help-Text `Icon` axis (default on).

props.name: characterLimit
props.description: Figma Help-Text `Character-Limitation`: custom text (e.g. "12/100"), or `true` to count the value against `maxLength`.

props.name: size
props.description: Short (sm, md…) or Figma (small, medium…) spelling.

props.name: leading
props.description: Before the value: an icon name (`"icon-mail-01-line"`, sized to the field) or any node (a unit, a picker).

props.name: trailing
props.description: After the value: an icon name (sized to the field) or any node (a unit, a picker, an action).

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Called with the new text on every change (next to the native `onChange(event)`, which still runs).

props.name: datePickerActions
props.description:
The calendar's Cancel + Submit (Figma Actions): a picked day is a draft until Submit writes it to the field; Cancel and
 Escape keep the date the field had.

props.name: minDate
props.description:
Earliest day the calendar lets people pick (DatePicker `minDate`); earlier days are disabled. A typed date before
it stays in the field and reaches `onValueChange` as usual, and the input is marked `aria-invalid` (Form and
ModalForm count it and focus it after a blocked submit). The field shows no message of its own: validate the value
and pass `error` ("Pick a date from 1 October").

props.name: maxDate
props.description:
Latest day the calendar lets people pick (DatePicker `maxDate`); later days are disabled. A typed date after it is
kept, reported and marked `aria-invalid` as for `minDate`: pass `error` to say why.

props.name: today
props.description:
The day the calendar treats as today (DatePicker `today`): its Today ring and the month it opens on while empty.
Default: the device clock.

components.name: DatePickerItem
components.description:
The day primitive from `.Primitives/Date-Picker/Item` (455:33517): Medium 32px on Corner-Radius/Action/Small,
Small 24px on Corner-Radius/Action/XSmall. The button paints the In-Range strip, its label span the day.
State=Today carries `aria-current="date"` (the calendar sets it on today's day in every state, selected included).

props.name: date
props.description:
The full date of this day. It names the button in the locale ("Wednesday, September 30, 2026"); without it the
name is the locale's "Day N". The calendar passes it for every day.

props.name: size
props.description: Medium 32px (default) or Small 24px; short (sm, md…) or Figma (small, medium…) spelling. Ignored on mobile.

props.name: device
props.description:
`mobile`: `.Primitives/Mobile-Date-Picker/Item` (9921:3283), a square that fills its grid column (40px in the
component, 50px in the 350px table of a 390px phone) with the day in Body/Base/Medium; same states and tokens as desktop.

props.name: type
props.description:
Figma Header Type: Interactive (month/year opens Select-Month-Year), Static (label only,
used by the Dual calendar) or Display (label only, no navigation slots).

props.name: back
props.description: Figma `Back` / `Next`. A hidden button keeps its 32px slot so the label stays centred (desktop).

props.name: device
props.description:
`mobile` (Date-Picker/Mobile 9923:3576): month and year in Heading/Subheading at the start, Back and Next together
at the end; a hidden button leaves no slot.

components.name: DatePickerAction
components.description: `.Primitives/Date-Picker/Action` (460:38871): Button/Main Small Tertiary "Cancel" + Primary "Submit", gap Spacing/Gap/XSmall.

props.name: action
props.description: Figma Action: `dual` (Cancel + Submit) or `single` (Submit only).

props.name: onCancel
props.description: Pressing Cancel (the Tertiary button).

props.name: onApply
props.description: Pressing Submit (the Primary button).

props.name: cancelLabel
props.description: Text of the Tertiary button. Default: the locale's "Cancel".

props.name: applyLabel
props.description: Text of the Primary button. Default: the locale's "Submit".

props.name: cancelDisabled
props.description: Cancel in its Button/Main Disabled state, e.g. while there is nothing to cancel.

props.name: applyDisabled
props.description: Submit in its Button/Main Disabled state, e.g. until a range has its end date.

components.name: DatePickerMonthYear
components.description:
`.Primitives/Date-Picker/Calendar` Type=Select-Month-Year: the focused month/year header, a
month wheel and a year wheel (Heading/4, 5 visible rows), then Cancel / Submit.

components.name: DatePickerTimePicker
components.description:
Figma `.Primitives/Date-Picker/Time-Picker` (460:38628): Input/Text-Field Small times with an AM/PM picker and
 Checkbox/Text "All day", Spacing/Gap/Medium apart (Gap/XSmall between a range side's field and its checkbox).

props.name: type
props.description:
Figma Type: `single` (From over To, one All day; the Single-Calendar) or `range` (From | To side by side, each with
 its own All day; the Dual-Calendar).

props.name: device
props.description: `mobile`: the time fields are Medium (phones keep full-size inputs); DatePicker passes its own `device`.

types.DatePickerRange: interface DatePickerRange { start: Date; end: Date | null; }
types.DatePickerTime: interface DatePickerTime { from: string | null; to: string | null; fromAllDay?: boolean; toAllDay?: boolean; }
